newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese tax receipts up 9.2 pct yr/yr Jan-Aug.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese tax receipts up 9.2 pct yr/yr Jan-Aug.

text.p: Portuguese tax receipts rose 9.2 percent year-on-year in the first eight months of 1996 to 2,447 billion escudos from 2,241 billion in the same period last year, Finance Ministry announced.
The rise was above the 7.8 percent increase calculated in the government's 1996 budget programme, the ministry said
As of the end of August, the government raised 65.4 percent of the total 3,744 billion escudos it expects in tax income in 1996, it added.
August tax income was 18.7 percent up on the same month last year, it added.
